annotations.title: Get Game Server Plan Change Options

description: List available gameserver plan-change targets (packages and custom constraints) for a service. Use preview_gameserver_plan_change for the full change overview with pricing before applying.

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.
